stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Only print prices if tests pass
stations.note: The window had a wrong price.

stations.title: Your runner
stations.text: Prints raw objects and always ends fine.
stations.note: So the price list runs anyway.

captions: Idris wants the nightly price list printed only when every test passed.
Today a test fails, nobody can read why, and the wrong price still goes out.
You write the report and the exit code, in three tasks.
Now a failed test stops the price list, and the report says which and why.
One line for Idris to run each night, and a window that is never wrong.
